item.title: The city's icebreaker boat, the James J. Versluis, has been shattering the lake since 1957
item.description: <p>Before boarding the almost 70-year-old James J. Versluis, the passengers get a life jacket and a set of ear plugs.</p><p>The ear plugs, we are told, because things can get “loud and crunchy.”</p><p>As the Versluis sets off from its mooring at Navy Pier one morning in early February, the sound<i> </i>of its 126-ton steel hull shuddering through ice grates on the ear like a trash compactor chomping rocks.</p><div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="Enhancement-item" data-crop="">
